title: Slash-palette descriptions differ from the design's command copy
observed: Registry descriptions: /help 'Show available commands', /clear 'Clear conversation history', /compact 'Summarize and compact the current context', /context 'Show context usage against the active tier', /cost 'Show token usage and cost for this session', /model 'Show or change the active model', /agents 'Show the subagents available for dispatch' (internal/commands/builtins.go:351-583).
expected: Design CMDS: /context 'Show context window usage', /cost 'Tokens and spend this session', /compact 'Summarize history to free context', /clear 'Start a fresh session', /model 'Switch model', /agents 'Manage subagents', /help 'Shortcuts and commands'.
